build: run and type-check the TypeScript sources without a build step

Node's native type stripping needs relative imports to carry the ".ts"
extension, so `node --test` can run the sources as they are. Configure
`tsc` to accept those specifiers and rewrite them to ".js" on emit, and
add `typecheck` (sources plus tests) and `build` scripts over
`typescript` and `@types/node` as dev dependencies. No runtime
dependency is added.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: resolve JSON Pointers against a JSON document (RFC 6901)

Add `resolvePointer(document, pointer)`, which returns the value a JSON
Pointer refers to, following RFC 6901 § 3 for the syntax and § 4 for the
evaluation. Failures throw `JsonPointerError`, whose `reason` tells a
malformed pointer from one the document does not resolve.

Evaluation follows the RFC's grammar rather than JavaScript property
lookup: on an array only the `array-index` form resolves, so `-`, `01`
and `length` do not; on an object only own members resolve, so
`/__proto__` fails unless the document declares it. Values are returned
in place, not copied, which the features to come need.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
